result:
If I could change one thing in the world, I think I would gently ease the misunderstandings between people—whether between individuals, cultures, or communities. Not by making everyone agree, but by helping everyone feel truly heard, even in disagreement. So many conflicts grow from fear or feeling invisible. If understanding became a little easier, maybe the world could feel a little less divided, and a little more connected.  

What would you change?
